negative_results.scope: CURRENT G9 grammar vs tested CURRENT G9 source constructs
negative_results.result: Published grammar rejects union types, comparisons, interface method signatures and relation-word operations in tested snippets, and silently misparses an if-control snippet as generic identifiers/set syntax. Independent E2B execution replicated the baseline defect in all 5/5 tested current cases.
negative_results.implication: Do not treat current grammar as release-ready parser contract. Repair parser/canonicalizer before semantic churn.
negative_results.does_not_prove: Does not refute G9 semantic concepts or prove no richer production parser exists elsewhere.

negative_results.result: Independent E2B replication passed union/comparison/interface-method/if cases but still failed the relation-word form because the relation token remained ambiguous against generic identifier lexing.
negative_results.implication: Do not freeze the first patch. Use an explicit declared relation/predicate surface or otherwise unambiguous syntax with typed symbol resolution; test undeclared/mutated relations adversarially.
negative_results.does_not_prove: Does not show that ClayCode needs new semantics; this remains a concrete grammar/resolution-layer defect.
